import sqlite3

def login(username, password):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('app.db')
    cur = conn.cursor()
    query = "SELECT id FROM users WHERE username='" + username + "' AND password='" + password + "'"
    cur.execute(query)
    return cur.fetchone() is not None
